title: Internal: Overdraft Courtesy Refunds - Repeat Overdrafts
content:
## Repeat Overdrafts

- If the account was charged another overdraft fee in the 90 days before the fee the customer is asking about, the courtesy refund is limited to 50% of that fee.
- Review the account's transactions with get_bank_account_transactions_9173 for earlier overdraft fees before applying the credit.
- If there is no earlier overdraft fee in that period, the standard courtesy refund applies.
